svg.title: Choose the source for Graph
svg.desc: In Editor, choose Graph on the activity rail, then select a Graph view. Journal and Wiki uses workspace documents and saved links. Code uses an authorized folder selected through File, Open folder, and displays loaded files, symbols and indexed relationships.
